result:
If I imagine it hypothetically - since I don't have personal desires or needs the way people do - I think the change with the biggest ripple effect would be something like this:

Everyone being able to really understand each other and feel understood in return. Not agreeing on everything, but having more curiosity, patience, and empathy in how we talk and listen.

A lot of other hard problems - conflict, loneliness, misinformation, how we take care of each other and the planet - get a little easier when people start from a place of genuinely trying to understand one another first.

What about you? If you could change one thing, what would you pick?
